def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")

    # --- Утечка: каждую таблицу фильтруем по её собственной дате появления ---
    # Позиции заказа известны с момента покупки заказа (ts)
    oi = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "product_id", "price", "freight_value", "ts"]
    ].copy()

    if oi.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=["f_dummy"])

    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]]
    oi = oi.merge(orders_sub, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi["ts"] = oi["ts"].fillna(oi["order_purchase_timestamp"])
    oi = oi[oi["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    oi["days_before"] = (seed_time - oi["ts"]).dt.days.astype(float)
    oi = oi[oi["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    if oi.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=["f_dummy"])

    # --- Платежи: известны с момента ts платежа ---
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Отзывы: известны только если созданы до seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_score_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_score_min=("review_score", "min"),
        review_count=("review_id", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    oi = oi.merge(pay, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi = oi.merge(rev, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi["review_score_mean"] = oi["review_score_mean"].fillna(3.0)
    oi["has_review"] = oi["review_count"].notna().astype(float)

    feat_cols = []

    def add_series(s, name):
        s = s.reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0)
        features[name] = s
        feat_cols.append(name)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)

    windows = [7, 30, 90, 365, None]
    for w in windows:
        if w is None:
            sub = oi
            tag = "all"
        else:
            sub = oi[oi["days_before"] < w]
            tag = f"{w}d"
        g = sub.groupby("product_id")
        add_series(g["order_id"].nunique(), f"count_{tag}")
        add_series(g["price"].sum(), f"sum_price_{tag}")
        add_series(g["price"].mean(), f"avg_price_{tag}")
        add_series(g["freight_value"].sum(), f"sum_freight_{tag}")
        add_series(g["payment_sum"].sum(), f"sum_payment_{tag}")
        add_series(g["payment_installments_mean"].mean(), f"avg_installments_{tag}")
        add_series(g["review_score_mean"].mean(), f"avg_review_{tag}")
        add_series(
            g["review_score_mean"].apply(lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() if len(x) else 0.0),
            f"pos_review_ratio_{tag}",
        )
        add_series(g["has_review"].mean(), f"review_coverage_{tag}")

    # Тренд: окно 30-60 дней назад против 0-30
    prev = oi[(oi["days_before"] >= 30) & (oi["days_before"] < 60)]
    gprev = prev.groupby("product_id")
    cnt_prev = gprev["order_id"].nunique().reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0)
    sum_prev = gprev["price"].sum().reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0)
    add_series(features["count_30d"] - cnt_prev, "count_trend_30d")
    add_series(features["sum_price_30d"] - sum_prev, "sum_price_trend_30d")

    # Тренд 90-180 против 0-90
    prev2 = oi[(oi["days_before"] >= 90) & (oi["days_before"] < 180)]
    gprev2 = prev2.groupby("product_id")
    add_series(
        features["count_90d"] - gprev2["order_id"].nunique().reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0),
        "count_trend_90d",
    )

    # Возраст, давность последней продажи
    first_sale = oi.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    last_sale = oi.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    add_series((seed_time - first_sale).dt.days.reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0), "age_days")
    add_series((seed_time - last_sale).dt.days.reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0), "recency_days")
    # Продавался ли товар в последний месяц
    add_series((features["recency_days"] <= 30).astype(float), "sold_last_30d")
    add_series((features["recency_days"] <= 90).astype(float), "sold_last_90d")

    # Средний интервал между продажами
    cnt_all = features["count_all"].replace(0, np.nan)
    add_series((features["age_days"] / cnt_all).fillna(0.0).clip(upper=365), "avg_days_between_sales")
    add_series((features["recency_days"] / features["avg_days_between_sales"].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(3.0).clip(upper=10), "recency_ratio")

    # Отзыв-флаги
    add_series(oi.groupby("product_id")["review_score_min"].min().fillna(5).eq(1).astype(float).reindex(idx, fill_value=0.0), "had_score1_ever")

    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(idx)
    return features.astype(float)
